visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot features a golden-brown, glistening French caramel almond crisp held between a thumb and forefinger, showcasing its dense layer of sliced almonds on top and flaky pastry beneath. (2) The scene transitions to a top-down view of a glass mixing bowl on a wooden surface where hands wearing transparent plastic gloves add cubes of butter and white powdered sugar. (3) A small glass bowl pours a dark liquid (vanilla extract) into the mixture, which is then creamed by hand into a smooth, pale yellow paste. (4) White flour is poured into the bowl and kneaded by hand into a solid dough, which is then transferred to a square baking pan lined with parchment paper and pressed flat. (5) A medium shot shows a male chef in a white professional uniform standing against a white brick wall background, gesturing with his hands as he explains the recipe. (6) A fork is used to systematically prick holes across the surface of the dough in the pan, followed by the pan being slid into a preheated oven. (7) In a white frying pan on a stove, butter is melted and combined with honey, maltose, and cream, creating a bubbling, golden caramel sauce. (8) A large bowl of sliced almonds is poured into the bubbling caramel, stirred until coated, and then the mixture is spread evenly over the pre-baked crust. (9) The final product is shown again, sliced into neat squares, with the caramelised almonds shining under bright studio lighting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 法式焦糖杏仁酥. [Logo]: wecook123. [Subtitle]: 法式焦糖杏仁酥. (2) [Subtitle]: 有加了一點香草精 跟我們的鮮奶油. (3) [Subtitle]: 所以它越嚼越香! (4) [Subtitle]: 還加上上面的杏仁酥 增加一點香氣在裡面. (5) [Subtitle]: 無鹽奶油 110g 室溫軟化一下 糖粉 25g 鹽巴 1g. (6) [Subtitle]: 加入一顆蛋黃 香草精 1g 攪拌均勻. (7) [Subtitle]: 糖吃進去之後 我們就可以直接拌我們的麵粉了 低筋麵粉 160g 把它拌開. (8) [Subtitle]: 成團了之後 就可以壓進我們的烤模裡面了. (9) [Subtitle]: 用手下去把它鋪平就可以了 進冷凍鬆弛一下 大概 15~20 分鐘. (10) [Subtitle]: 鬆弛好了 開始戳洞 間距大概 1 公分. (11) [Subtitle]: 換個方向戳 還是要平均戳一下. (12) [Subtitle]: 進烤箱 180 度 烤 20 分鐘. (13) [Subtitle]: 做焦糖醬 奶油 麥芽糖 35g 蜂蜜 20g 鮮奶油 50g 白糖 20g 鹽 1g. (14) [Subtitle]: 起泡之後下杏仁片(160g) 關火 用餘溫下去拌. (15) [Subtitle]: 烤了半生熟的塔殼 鋪進去就可以了. (16) [Subtitle]: 進烤箱 180 度 烤 15~20 分鐘. (17) [Subtitle]: 大家也可以在家 自己試做看看.
